headline: Dangee Dums declares financial results for period ended September 30, 2026
hook: September financials submitted to the exchange
summary: Dangee Dums Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine corporate filings of this nature provide baseline operational data for the company during the quarter. Retail investors tracking the SME space can review these filings for specific revenue and margin trends. The disclosure allows shareholders to assess the company's financial health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly metrics update for small-cap holders.

headline: Dangee Dums files Regulation 74(5) certificate for Q2 FY27
hook: Routine compliance filing for Dangee Dums
summary: Dangee Dums has submitted its Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This document confirms that the company's depository participant has verified and cancelled share certificates after dematerialization. It is a standard procedural requirement for listed companies to ensure accurate records of share transfers. The filing provides no change to the company's financial position or operational outlook.
why_it_matters: No material impact on share price or investor holdings.
